_about: The shipped defaults for study_mode.json: the documented fallback for any bad or missing value there. Keep the two equal (scripts/test_study_mode_config.py checks). What turns the timer on and off is NOT here: that is tool_policy.json study_commands.

timings._about: Minutes per phase, how often the clock checks its wall-clock deadline (also how fast the badge follows a dragged orb), and how long a phase alert stays up before tidying itself away.

sizes._about: Logical pixels (scaled by the screen's DPI). badge_tuck is how far inside the orb window its ring's outer edge sits; badge_gap the clear space between pill and ring; screen_margin where the badge sits with no orb.

fonts._about: Point sizes in the bubble and the badge.

_command_strip: Politeness removed from a whole-message command before tool_policy.json study_commands is tried (a regex; matched lower-cased).

phases._about: Everything said about one phase. alert_* is the bubble when the phase starts ({n} = its minutes); status_* the bubble when the badge is clicked ({left} = minutes left); footer the round line ({round}, {time} = when this phase ends); badge the countdown pill's word; menu the tray menu's word; block/doing/next feed the sentences in 'wording'.

study.alert_line: {n} minutes, starting now. Back to it.
study.status_line: {left} min left of this study block.

rest.alert_line: Nice work -- take {n} minutes. Stand up, drink some water.

wording._about: The bubble's links, the badge and tray-menu lines, and every sentence the model's study tools return. Tool results say only what actually happened: 'nothing was paused' when nothing ran is read by brain._confirms_nothing as no action taken, so keep that sense if you reword them.
wording.paused_state: Study session paused: {left} min left of the {block}, round {round}. Resume to continue.
wording.running_state: Study session running: {doing}, {left} min left of this {block}, round {round}; {next} at {time}.
wording.no_clock: Study mode isn't available in this process (no tray running), so nothing happened. Tell him plainly.
wording.no_clock_status: No study session is running (study mode isn't set up in this process).
wording.started: Study session started: {study_min} minutes of study, then a {rest_min}-minute rest; rest at {time}.
wording.not_running_pause: No study session is running, so nothing was paused.
wording.paused: Study session paused with {left} min left of the current block.
wording.not_running_resume: No study session is running, so nothing was resumed. Start one if he wants one.
wording.resumed: Study session resumed: {left} min left, next switch at {time}.
wording.not_running_stop: No study session was running, so nothing was stopped.
